settings.required_discussion_label: Require a declaration when starting a discussion
settings.required_discussion_help: Discussions cannot be published until at least one declaration is selected.
settings.required_reply_help: Replies cannot be published until at least one declaration is selected.
settings.show_original_in_post_header_label: Show original and repost tags in the post header
settings.show_original_in_post_header_help: When enabled, “Original” and “Repost” appear as tags in the post header and are omitted from the declaration summary above the post body.
settings.show_in_user_post_lists_label: Show creator declarations in profile Posts lists
settings.show_in_user_post_lists_help: When enabled, creator declarations are displayed with posts in user profile Posts lists.
settings.order_help: Separate declaration keys with commas. Missing keys are appended automatically. Available keys are original, repost, ai_generated, fictional, personal_opinion, professional, sensitive, self_promotion, and sponsored.

display.title: Creator declarations
display.disclaimer: These declarations were provided by the author and have not been verified by the forum.
display.original_tooltip: Original content. Do not reproduce without permission.
display.repost_tooltip: Reposted content. Copyright belongs to the original author.

info_modal.title: About this declaration
info_modal.heading: Why am I seeing this notice?
info_modal.explanation: This notice was added by the author, who declared this post as “{declarations}”.
info_modal.disclaimer: These declarations have not been verified or certified by the forum. Please consider them together with the post.

modal.title: Self Declarations
modal.help: Select the declarations that apply to this post. They provide context and do not represent the forum's views.

validation.required: At least one declaration is required.
validation.details_too_long: Declaration details may not exceed 500 characters.
validation.repost_url_required: A valid source URL is required for reposted content.
validation.source_conflict: Original and reposted content declarations cannot be selected at the same time.

original.label: Original content
original.help: The content was primarily created by the author and is not a direct repost.

repost.label: Reposted or quoted content
repost.help: The content includes substantial material from another author or source.

ai_generated.label: AI-generated content
ai_generated.help: All or a significant part of the content was created or edited with generative AI.
ai_generated.details_placeholder: Optionally name the AI tool or add context

fictional.label: Fictional or staged content
fictional.help: The content contains fictional events, role-play, or staged scenes.

personal_opinion.label: Personal opinions or perspectives
personal_opinion.help: This content primarily expresses the author's personal views, judgments, or experiences and does not represent universal facts or professional conclusions.

professional.label: Dangerous behavior; do not imitate
professional.help: Imitating this activity without suitable expertise may create a safety risk.

sensitive.label: Potentially disturbing
sensitive.help: The content may include disturbing, frightening, or sensitive descriptions.

self_promotion.label: Contains marketing or promotional information
self_promotion.help: The content promotes products or services from the author, their organization, or third parties and may involve affiliate commissions or other compensation.

sponsored.label: Paid partnership, sponsorship, or material interest
sponsored.help: A third party provided payment, gifts, or another material benefit.
sponsored.details_placeholder: Optionally name the partner or describe the relationship
